files.description: EHI Data Dictionary v1.0 — 63-page PDF (generated from Google Sheets, last modified 9/9/2025) documenting 125 tables and ~2700 columns across all data domains in the OncoEMR EHI export. Covers demographics, diagnoses, medications, orders, billing, insurance, encounters, clinical notes, labs, vitals, allergies, immunizations, family history, care plans, staging, treatment pathways, and more. Specifies export format as CSV (single patient) and Parquet (population). This is the primary artifact.
OncoEMR ONC Certification page HTML. Contains listing of all certified criteria, relied-upon software, costs, SVAP disclosures, and the link to the EHI data dictionary PDF.
Screenshot of the EHI Export Documentation section on the certification page, showing the link to the data dictionary.
Full-page screenshot of the OncoEMR ONC Certification page.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the EHI data dictionary PDF using pdftotext and extracts structured JSON with all tables, columns, types, nullable flags, and descriptions.
Structured JSON extraction of the full EHI data dictionary: 125 tables, 2689 columns with names, data types, nullable flags, and descriptions. Includes export format metadata.
Tables categorized by clinical/billing data domain (23 categories) with summary statistics.
Enrichment run instructions, input/output documentation, and known parsing limitations.
